Messages.Author: as...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
Does one pay for Sibyl´s Tounge even if the named item is not found in
the deck?
If so - why? (What rule?)
What is the "status" of the failed action? (failed, unsuccessful,
fizzled - gee, all these terminology confuses me)
Thanks.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
IANLSJ, but I'm pretty sure of these answers:

as...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Does one pay for Sibyl愀 Tounge even if the named item is not found in
> the deck?

Yes.

> If so - why? (What rule?)

Because the action was successful. "Searching" doesn't require finding
something, even if the card is there.

> What is the "status" of the failed action? (failed, unsuccessful,
> fizzled - gee, all these terminology confuses me)

The action is successful.

Similarly, you can use Magic of the Smith, find nothing, and it still
counts as a successful equip action (i.e. for Guruhi Are The Land).
